name: Custom Shape 2-Layer Embossed Mirror Acrylic Sign
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material:
    - Crafted from 2 layers of acrylic for a dimensional and elegant decorative sign.
                 +) Layer 1: Mirror Acrylic 3mm with 1-sided printing.
                 +) Layer 2: Transparent Acrylic 2mm with 1-sided printing.
    - The sign features a reflective mirror acrylic base paired with a transparent acrylic top layer for a premium layered appearance.
    - The transparent top layer includes glossy raised printed lines, adding texture, depth, and a refined stained-glass-inspired effect.
    - Available in:
                 +) Gold Mirror Acrylic
                 +) Silver Mirror Acrylic
    - Custom-shape construction allows the sign to be produced in elegant silhouettes and decorative layouts to match personalized artwork and event themes.
     
  • Sizes & Dimensions:
    - Available size: 16 x 24 in ~ 40.64 x 60.96 cm
    📌 Note: The dimensions of the product may vary slightly depending on the design, as sizes are not fixed.
     
  • Printing Technology:
    - Both layers feature high-quality 1-sided UV printing for crisp text, vivid colors, and detailed personalized artwork.
    - The Mirror Acrylic base provides a smooth reflective foundation that enhances the overall premium look of the design.
    - The Transparent Acrylic top layer features glossy embossed printed lines that create raised contour effects and add visible dimension.
    - This 2-layer construction creates a rich visual effect with added depth, layered detail, and an elegant stained-glass-inspired finish.
    - Precision cutting is used to create clean edges and custom-shaped silhouettes for decorative sign designs.
    📌 Please Note: The raised glossy texture is printed on the transparent acrylic top layer and will only appear in the areas included in the customer’s artwork file.

 

  • Function & Usage:
    - Designed as a personalized decorative sign for weddings, engagements, bridal showers, receptions, anniversaries, and other special celebrations.
    - Suitable for displaying welcome messages, couple names, event dates, invitations, and themed decorative artwork.
    - Ideal for use as a welcome sign, entrance display, ceremony décor, reception decoration, backdrop accent, or keepsake sign.
    - The mirror acrylic base adds a reflective, elegant effect, while the raised glossy lines on the transparent layer enhance the visual depth of floral and ornamental artwork.
    - Durable layered construction makes the sign suitable for event display and long-lasting keepsake use.
    - Especially suitable for designs inspired by stained glass, floral frames, and elegant event décor themes.
     
  • Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:
    - A meaningful personalized gift for couples, newlyweds, family members, friends, and loved ones.
    - Perfect for weddings, engagements, bridal showers, anniversaries, vow renewals, and milestone celebrations.
    - Great for creating custom event signage featuring names, meaningful dates, welcome wording, and decorative artwork.
    - Ideal as a memorable keepsake that can continue to be displayed after the event.
    - A beautiful personalized décor piece that combines reflective Gold or Silver Mirror Acrylic with a transparent embossed top layer for a distinctive premium finish.

 

SPECIFICATION

  • Processing Time: 3 – 5 working days average after payment and all designs updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 6 – 9 working days on average (US)
  • Packaging: 1x Custom Shape 2-Layer Embossed Mirror Acrylic Sign

 

NOTE

  • Actual color may be slightly different from the image due to different monitor and light effects.
  • Please allow 0.3-0.5 cm differences due to manual measurement.
guideLine:
Print Guidelines

 

  • Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. 
  • Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. 
  • Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

 

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as an .emb, .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.

 

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

 

  • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.
  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
